tmdb:1596302.title: The Oldest Person in the World
tmdb:1596302.overview: A decade-long global journey chronicles the ever-changing record holders of the title of oldest person alive. What begins as a portrait of longevity becomes a meditation on the passage of time, the randomness of fate, and the joy and profound human experience of being alive.

tmdb:1596326.title: Barbara Forever
tmdb:1596326.overview: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

t:filipinana.title: Filipiñana
t:filipinana.overview: Amid stifling heat and pervasive drought, Isabel (Jorrybell Agoto), a 17-year-old Ilokana from the rural north, works at a posh country club outside Manila, lining up golf balls for powerful men to drive into the verdant horizon. New to the job, she wanders the immaculate grounds sampling its luxuries as members, including an industrialist and his expatriate niece, the club president and his pampered wife, and a slew of Chinese tourists, engage in a complex dance with the club’s doting and subservient staff. But something is rotting beneath the pristine fairways of the elite resort, as Isabel discovers when she tries to return a mislaid golf club to its patriarchal director, Dr. Palanca (Teroy Guzman). The deeper she journeys into its most exclusive corners, the closer she gets to the violent truths of the club, her native Philippines, and her own past..

tmdb:1631822.title: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
tmdb:1631822.overview: From a lonely childhood to literary fame, her life was shaped by devotion to nature, paying attention, and the long journey toward learning to love and to be loved.  If poetry had a pop icon, Mary Oliver would be it.

tmdb:11171.title: Mysterious Skin
tmdb:11171.overview: A teenage hustler and a young man obsessed with alien abductions cross paths, together discovering a horrible, liberating truth.

t:re vision my name aint suzie.key: t:re vision my name aint suzie
t:re vision my name aint suzie.title: Re:Vision: My Name Ain’t Suzie
t:re vision my name aint suzie.overview: In My Name Ain’t Suzie, Angie Chen offers a powerful rebuke to the colonial imagination of films such as The World of Suzie Wong (1960), bringing post-war Hong Kong to life on her own terms. Shui-Mei (Patricia Ha), a “salt water girl” from the outskirts of the city, finds a way out of poverty in the Red Light district of Wan Chai. Over the years, she rises through the ranks, discovering a world of equal hardship and sisterly camaraderie, where colorful characters abound – among them Jimmy (Anthony Wong, in his debut role), a mixed-race kid looking for his father in the crowd of thirsty American sailors.

tmdb:22500.title: Gandahar
tmdb:22500.overview: On the planet Gandahar where peace reigns and poverty is unknown, this utopian lifestyle is upset by reports of people at the outlying frontiers being turned to stone. Sylvain is sent to investigate this mysterious threat.

t:re vision valley of the bees.key: t:re vision valley of the bees
t:re vision valley of the bees.title: Re:Vision: Valley of the Bees
t:re vision valley of the bees.overview: While his name lacks the recognition of other Eastern European filmmakers, writer / director / occasional actor František Vláčil could be considered among the greatest motion picture practitioners on the strength of his adaptation of Marketa Lazarová alone. Yet his follow-up, The Valley of the Bees [Údolí včel], is a similarly stunning period-piece of archetypal drama (and, like its predecessor and other works by the filmmaker, features an extraordinary score by Zdeněk Liška).

t:re vision dakan.title: Re:Vision: Dakan
t:re vision dakan.overview: Dakan follows two young men, Manga and Sori, as they navigate young love of a kind their families cannot abide. Seen by Manga’s mother as a mental illness, and Sori’s father as a weakness to overcome, both men struggle to live the “right way”. Self-denial, tradition and superstition merge in attempts to rid the young lovers of their passions.

tmdb:916.title: Bullitt
tmdb:916.overview: Senator Walter Chalmers is aiming to take down mob boss Pete Ross with the help of testimony from the criminal's hothead brother Johnny, who is in protective custody in San Francisco under the watch of police lieutenant Frank Bullitt. When a pair of mob hitmen enter the scene, Bullitt follows their trail through a maze of complications and double-crosses. This thriller includes one of the most famous car chases ever filmed.

t:re vision the outcasts.title: Re:Vision: The Outcasts
t:re vision the outcasts.overview: Written and directed by Robert Wynne-Simmons (writer of folk-horror masterpiece Blood on Satan’s Claw), and starring legendary Irish actors Cyril Cusack and Mick Lally, The Outcasts was the first major feature film funded in Ireland in forty years. Set in the earlier 1800s, an era of great poverty and no little superstition in pre-Famine Ireland, The Outcasts centers Maura (Mary Ryan), one of three daughters, a peculiar young woman largely ostracized by her rural Irish community due to her “abnormal” behavior. In great need of an ally, Maura aligns herself with the much feared Scarf Michael, whose power over the locals seems to tap into a world beyond our own.

t:re vision i am with a monk.key: t:re vision i am with a monk
t:re vision i am with a monk.title: Re:Vision: I Am With A Monk
t:re vision i am with a monk.overview: Two legendary Thai actors, Sombat Methanee and Sorapong Chatree, form an unlikely duo of a wanderer on the run and reluctant monk, facing danger at every turn. Khom Akadet’s 1980s actioner is thrilling not only in its fight scenes, but also in the careful registers between.

t:dreamers and i.title: The Dreamers And I
t:dreamers and i.overview: Three immigrant entrepreneurs arrive in the U.S. to make their high-tech dreams come true. Carlos de la Lama-Noriega from Spain is the founder of Startup Embassy, a so-called hacker house that offers an affordable, welcoming live/work community of like-minded geeks as they labor in obscurity. Habibe Turfan, a materials scientist from Turkey, is working on her dream project, which she calls Stealth Startup. AI engineer Lucas Gozálvez, also from Spain, is CEO of another startup, Caleida, and the recent author of “The Hunger Games of Coding: Will AI Replace Developers or Trigger a Brutal Surge in Demand.”

t:re vision araya.title: Re:Vision: Araya
t:re vision araya.overview: Araya captures nearly five-hundred years of history condensed into a speculative single day (albeit filmed with her cinematographer Giuseppe Nisoli over four weeks, from September to October), with a tripartite structure following the lives of three families in three nearby villages.

tmdb:1620313.title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
tmdb:1620313.overview: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

t:re vision the dislocation of amber.key: t:re vision the dislocation of amber
t:re vision the dislocation of amber.title: Re:Vision: The Dislocation of Amber
t:re vision the dislocation of amber.overview: In The Dislocation of Amber, director Hussein Shariffe uses abandoned areas of the Sudanese city of Suakin to stage abstracted, ambiguous performances. His actors move through corners, windows, doorways like shadows of this once thriving port, now fallen to ruin. Lacerating sunshine and intense color dominate the frame, while musician Abdel-Aziz Dawoud chants the words of the Sufi poem “The Wine Ode” by Ibn Al-Faridh. Shariffe himself said this about Suakin in 1974 — “Only faint traces of its ancient affluence are apparent today … a dimmed reflection in a cracked mirror; empty eyes with the stars in a different house, laughter in another room.”

t:re vision gehenu lamai the girls.key: t:re vision gehenu lamai the girls
t:re vision gehenu lamai the girls.title: Re:Vision: Gehenu Lamai (The Girls)
t:re vision gehenu lamai the girls.overview: Sumitra Peries’s Gehenu Lamai [The Girls] —the first feature directed by a woman in Sri Lanka—is a close observation of a life shrinking. So much weight is placed on girls worldwide, and the girls of Gehenu Lamai are no different. Expected to care-give, earn, and behave respectably no matter the cost, the central girls of the film, sisters Kusum and Soma, bear much responsibility. Despite very different approaches to their constraints, some outcomes cannot be avoided.

t:re vision lepers and sex aka santo vs.key: t:re vision lepers and sex aka santo vs the riders of terror
t:re vision lepers and sex aka santo vs.title: Re:Vision: Lepers & Sex AKA Santo vs The Riders of Terror
t:re vision lepers and sex aka santo vs.overview: Mexico’s legendary Calderon film empire’s most famous and longest-running series was that of El Santo, the silver-masked wrestling hero (Rodolfo Guzman), who starred in some 50-odd productions from 1959 to the mid-1980s. But one of the most gonzo – and seldom seen – entries in the series is Los Leprosos y el Sexo with our hero battling a murderous mob of escaped lepers in a small town, resulting in a Western-cum-horror-cum-action picture, but with a twist.

t:re vision tri.title: Re:Vision: Tri
t:re vision tri.overview: Featuring searingly unforgettable black and white cinematography by Tomislav Pinter, Tri is structured as a triptych with stories set at the beginning, middle and end of the Second World War in Yugoslavia (1941-1944). The protagonist is a partisan portrayed by Velimir Bata Živojinović though according to the director, “The real protagonist of this film is death. In this film, it appears in three forms – as punishment, as victim, and as an expression of the senselessness of war. One needs to be against war, but one needs to be against war as a matter of principle, against anybody who wages war, and also against those who create reasons for war.” — Robert Byrne

t:re vision the waiting room.title: Re:Vision: The Waiting Room
t:re vision the waiting room.overview: Filmmaker Karen Sperling writes, directs, produces, and stars in The Waiting Room (1973), a groundbreaking film created by a 35-woman film crew working in the deserted wing of a psychiatric facility on Manhattan’s Ward Island. This renegade psychodrama captures the depths of feminine ambivalence in the shadow of a looming specter — compulsory domesticity. The ‘waiting room’ manifests as quotidian and institutional anterooms in which a young woman mulls over a marriage proposal. Belonging squarely to the quasi Brechtian feminist avant-garde forged by Yvonne Rainer, Chantal Akerman, and Cecelia Condit, The Waiting Room has remarkably gone unseen for 50 years.

t:re vision the garden of eden.key: t:re vision the garden of eden
t:re vision the garden of eden.title: Re:Vision: The Garden of Eden
t:re vision the garden of eden.overview: The Garden of Eden is best described as either a pre-pre-code or a proto-screwball comedy. Technically it is a silent film, but skimpy costumes, gender play, and sexual innuendo undeniably identify it as a film confidently striding headlong into the early 1930s. Further evidence is provided by the Film Daily reviewer who complained at the time, “It is utterly absurd and cheap pandering to dirty-minded people who gloat over an undressed woman” and by Montreal censors that demanded the last reel be eliminated entirely. Fortunately, the archived prints at George Eastman Museum and the Library of Congress, which form the basis of this restoration, eluded the censors’ wrath and you will have the pleasure of seeing the scandalous footage that Canadian audiences were denied. — Robert Byrne

t:re vision 8 girls in a boat.key: t:re vision 8 girls in a boat
t:re vision 8 girls in a boat.title: Re:Vision: 8 Girls in a Boat
t:re vision 8 girls in a boat.overview: At an all-girls school in Switzerland, Christa Storm (Dorothy Wilson) is a star pupil and stroke seat on the rowing team, but her clandestine affair with a young chemist from another college leads her into trouble when she discovers she’s pregnant. As Christa’s attention in school slips, she incurs the discipline of the team’s steely coach, Hannah (Kay Johnson), who removes her from the boat and threatens expulsion. Worse, Christa’s businessman father (Walter Connelly) objects to marriage between Christa and David over concerns that David’s studies doom him to a life of poverty. How will Christa and her coming baby keep an even keel through all this choppy water?

t:re vision melody of murder.title: Re:Vision: Melody of Murder
t:re vision melody of murder.overview: At an all-girls school in Switzerland, Christa Storm (Dorothy Wilson) is a star pupil and stroke seat on the rowing team, but her clandestine affair with a young chemist from another college leads her into trouble when she discovers she’s pregnant. As Christa’s attention in school slips, she incurs the discipline of the team’s steely coach, Hannah (Kay Johnson), who removes her from the boat and threatens expulsion. Worse, Christa’s businessman father (Walter Connelly) objects to marriage between Christa and David over concerns that David’s studies doom him to a life of poverty. How will Christa and her coming baby keep an even keel through all this choppy water?

tmdb:540.title: D.E.B.S.
tmdb:540.overview: The star of a team of teenage crime fighters falls for the alluring villainess she must bring to justice.

tmdb:44214.title: Black Swan
tmdb:44214.overview: A committed dancer struggles to maintain her sanity after winning the lead role in a production of Tchaikovsky's "Swan Lake."

tmdb:10494.title: Perfect Blue
tmdb:10494.overview: Rising pop star Mima Kirigoe quits singing to pursue a career as an actress. After she takes up a role on a popular detective show, her handlers and collaborators begin turning up murdered. Harboring feelings of guilt and haunted by visions of her former self, Mima's reality and fantasy meld into a frenzied paranoia.

tmdb:1599181.title: Chronovisor
tmdb:1599181.overview: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.

tmdb:25623.title: House
tmdb:25623.overview: Hoping to find a sense of connection to her late mother, Gorgeous takes a trip with her friends to visit her aunt's ancestral house in the countryside. The girls soon discover that there is more to the old house than meets the eye.

tmdb:77350.title: Unzipped
tmdb:77350.overview: Isaac Mizrahi, one of the most successful designers in high fashion, plans his fall 1994 collection.

tmdb:1556.title: Funeral Parade of Roses
tmdb:1556.overview: In 1960s Tokyo, Gonda owns a bar in which the gay, cross-dresser, and trans scenes meet. Gonda is in a relationship with the madam of the bar, Leda. As the younger Eddie starts a passionate affair with Gonda, she ignites the jealousy of Leda, unaware of another kind of history between them.

tmdb:104287.title: Dangerous Encounters of the First Kind
tmdb:104287.overview: Three lazybones friends manufacture a firebomb and place it in a cinema. Pearl, a sadistic young girl, has observed the scene, follows the bombers and starts to manipulate them. The four criminals plan more and more daring acts.

tmdb:1193495.title: Ashima
tmdb:1193495.overview: One of the world’s youngest elite rock climbers, Ashima Shiraishi spent her formative years breaking numerous age-based climbing milestones, spurred on by her number one fan and coach, her father, Poppo a retired Butoh dancer and avant-garde performer with no formal climbing experience. When these New Yorkers travel to South Africa to conquer a V14 boulder problem, father and daughter must face their interpersonal struggles in tandem with the challenging ascent.

tmdb:30959.title: Kwaidan
tmdb:30959.overview: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden, but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts. An author relates the story of a samurai who sees another warrior's reflection in his teacup.

tmdb:63025.title: A Lizard in a Woman's Skin
tmdb:63025.overview: Carol Hammond, daughter of a politician, has vivid nightmares involving sex orgies and LSD. In a dream, she murders a neighbor she envies and wakes up to a real investigation into her neighbor's murder.

t:zoe presents memorex rexsexex y mas.key: t:zoe presents memorex rexsexex y mas
t:zoe presents memorex rexsexex y mas.title: Zoé Presents: Memorex + Rexsexex y Más
t:zoe presents memorex rexsexex y mas.overview:
6 GNP Stadiums in Mexico City. Over 380,000 souls. What happened across those six nights was far
more than an unprecedented record for Mexican rock; it was a historic and intimate gathering between a
band that has soundtracked entire universes and a multigenerational fanbase that is more devoted than
ever. This is the story of what vibrated on stage and what was kept in the hearts of the fans: an unfiltered
breakdown of the absolute magnetism, nostalgia, and enduring relevance of Zoé.

tmdb:744.title: Top Gun
tmdb:744.overview: For Lieutenant Pete 'Maverick' Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick 'Goose' Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy, as well as personal demons, will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

tmdb:1134909.title: River of Life LGBTQ+
tmdb:1134909.overview: This documentary film follows a 10-week drama therapy workshop, with 13 multigenerational queer participants, coming together to unpack internalized queerphobia and the evolution of the LGBTQ+ community.

tmdb:1791.title: The Piano Teacher
tmdb:1791.overview: Erika Kohut, a sexually repressed piano teacher living with her domineering mother, meets a young man who starts romantically pursuing her.

tmdb:50173.title: Jigoku
tmdb:50173.overview: A group of sinners involved in interconnected tales of murder, revenge, deceit and adultery all meet at the Gates of Hell.

tmdb:2649.title: The Game
tmdb:2649.overview: In honor of his birthday, San Francisco banker Nicholas Van Orton, a financial genius and a cold-hearted loner, receives an unusual present from his younger brother, Conrad: a gift certificate to play a unique kind of game. In nary a nanosecond, Nicholas finds himself consumed by a dangerous set of ever-changing rules, unable to distinguish where the charade ends and reality begins.

tmdb:7857.title: Amarcord
tmdb:7857.overview: In an Italian seaside town, young Titta gets into trouble with his friends and watches various local eccentrics as they engage in often absurd behavior. Frequently clashing with his stern father and defended by his doting mother, Titta witnesses the actions of a wide range of characters, from his extended family to Fascist loyalists to sensual women, with certain moments shifting into fantastical scenarios.

tmdb:3019.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
tmdb:3019.overview: Dr. Henry Jekyll believes that there are two distinct sides to men: one that is good and one that is evil. He believes that by separating the two, man can become liberated. He succeeds in his experiments with chemicals to accomplish this and transforms into Hyde to commit horrendous crimes. When he discontinues use of the drug, it is already too late.

tmdb:884551.title: Ghost Dog
tmdb:884551.overview: Ever wonder what your dog would say to you if he/she could speak? When a broken hearted man's Halloween wish comes true he winds up paying a price he never saw coming.

tmdb:1596296.title: The History of Concrete
tmdb:1596296.overview: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

tmdb:36685.title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
tmdb:36685.overview: After getting a flat tire in the middle of nowhere, newly engaged couple Brad and Janet encounter the eerie mansion of the flamboyant, seductive Dr Frank-N-Furter and a variety of eccentric characters. Through elaborate dance and rock music, the mad scientist unveils his latest creation: a perfect, muscular man.

tmdb:27031.title: Samurai Rebellion
tmdb:27031.overview: The mother of a feudal lord's only heir is kidnapped by the lord. Her husband and his samurai father must decide whether to accept the unjust decision, or risk death to rescue her.

tmdb:142773.title: Queen: Budapest
tmdb:142773.overview: On July 27, 1986, Queen performed the largest-ever stadium concert at the Népstadion in Budapest in front of 80,000 ecstatic fans. The concert was part of the famed Magic Tour, which was the last time the band toured with lead singer Freddie Mercury.

tmdb:1765982.title: Bea Arthur: The Documentary
tmdb:1765982.overview: An intimate portrait of the actress celebrated for Maude, The Golden Girls and Mame. Built around a previously unseen interview conducted by producer and director Dan Watt, the film traces Arthur’s path from The New School and New York theatre to Broadway and television. Through Arthur’s own reflections and interviews with colleagues and close friends, the documentary looks beyond the tall, hilariously brassy public persona to reveal a woman who was also sensitive, vulnerable, compassionate and deeply committed to the people and causes she valued.

tmdb:1285895.title: Late Fame
tmdb:1285895.overview: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

tmdb:41050.title: La Notte
tmdb:41050.overview: A day in the life of an unfaithful married couple and their steadily deteriorating relationship in Milan.

tmdb:522.title: Ed Wood
tmdb:522.overview: The mostly true story of the legendary "worst director of all time", who, with the help of his strange friends, filmed countless B-movies without ever becoming famous or successful.

tmdb:8392.title: My Neighbor Totoro
tmdb:8392.overview: Two sisters move to the country with their father in order to be closer to their hospitalized mother, and discover the surrounding trees are inhabited by Totoros, magical spirits of the forest. When the youngest runs away from home, the older sister seeks help from the spirits to find her.

tmdb:1052599.title: Songs of Slow Burning Earth
tmdb:1052599.overview: Reflective observations of Ukraine in wartime are interwoven with eye-witness accounts to contemplate the ultimate tragedy: the normalization of war.

tmdb:507022.title: Comedy
tmdb:507022.overview: During Ireland's War of Independence, a five-year-old girl sets out to save her village from the English army by trying to enlist the help of the rumored Black Swordsman, who only takes books of a certain genre as payment.

tmdb:98096.title: Live Music
tmdb:98096.overview: A crowdsourced animated musical about a rock n' roll guitar that falls in love to the wrong song but ends up with the violin of his dreams.

tmdb:182227.title: Love Massacre
tmdb:182227.overview: Set in San Francisco, Love Massacre follows college student Ivy as she tries to help her friend Joy recover from a breakup. Ivy soon becomes involved with Joy's married brother Chu Chung, who spirals into senseless violence as he breaks into Ivy's dormitory and goes on a delirious killing spree.

tmdb:21588.title: Cemetery Man
tmdb:21588.overview: Francesco Dellamorte  is the groundskeeper at a cemetery where the dead just won’t stay dead—and it’s up to him to deal with those who come back to life with a hunger for human flesh. But Dellamorte’s job soon becomes much more complicated when he falls for an enigmatic young woman whose husband has recently died.

tmdb:793.title: Blue Velvet
tmdb:793.overview: The discovery of a severed human ear found in a field leads a young man on an investigation related to a beautiful, mysterious nightclub singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.

tmdb:10802.title: Showgirls
tmdb:10802.overview: Fresh to Las Vegas with no connections, Nomi Malone takes a job as an exotic dancer. Her talents are quickly noticed by Cristal, a headlining dancer who senses an opportunity to bolster her own act. But Nomi won’t play second fiddle and soon begins her venomous path to the top, ruthlessly backstabbing anyone who gets in her way.

tmdb:402.title: Basic Instinct
tmdb:402.overview: Catherine, a novelist with an insatiable sexual appetite, becomes a prime suspect when her boyfriend is brutally murdered -- a crime she had described in her latest story.

tmdb:4011.title: Beetlejuice
tmdb:4011.overview: A newly dead New England couple seeks help from a deranged demon exorcist to scare an affluent New York family out of their home.

tmdb:3107.title: Destroy All Monsters
tmdb:3107.overview: At the turn of the century, all of the Earth's monsters have been rounded up and kept safely on Monsterland. Chaos erupts when a race of she-aliens known as the Kilaaks unleash the monsters across the world.

tmdb:1214554.title: DEVO
tmdb:1214554.overview: Originally formed amidst the chaos of the 1970 Kent State anti-Vietnam War protest killings, the not quite new wave band Devo scored a hit with "Whip It" and gained mainstream success with their message of societal "de-evolution."

tmdb:1410939.title: Dire Duplicity
tmdb:1410939.overview: A tormented secret agent with emotional and psychological problems attempts to stop an international cyber attack. This dark emotional mystery intensifies as he is betrayed by those he trusts and loves.

tmdb:4816.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
tmdb:4816.overview: A Black hitman who models after the samurai of old finds himself targeted for death by the mob.

tmdb:9064.title: Hellbound: Hellraiser II
tmdb:9064.overview: Now confined to a mental hospital, young Kirsty insists her supposedly dead father is actually stuck in Hell following his wife’s betrayal. Few believe the young woman’s lurid stories aside from the thrill-seeking Dr. Channard. Kirsty is undeterred and, with the help of a fellow patient, heads to Hell for a rescue.

tmdb:9003.title: Hellraiser
tmdb:9003.overview: A hedonistic man finds a mysterious puzzle box that summons a group of gruesome beings known as the Cenobites. These otherworldly entities open the doors to a dominion where pain and pleasure are indivisible.

tmdb:9353.title: Nacho Libre
tmdb:9353.overview: Ignacio, a disrespected cook at a Mexican monastery, can barely afford to feed the orphans who live there. Inspired by a local wrestling hero, he decides to moonlight as the not-so-famous Luchador "Nacho Libre" to earn money for the monastery -- not to mention the admiration of beautiful nun Sister Encarnación.

tmdb:14353.title: Repo! The Genetic Opera
tmdb:14353.overview: By the year 2056, an epidemic of organ failures has devastated the planet. The megacorporation GeneCo provides organ transplants on a payment plan — and those unable to fulfill their plans have their organs repossessed. In the midst of this, a sickly teenager discovers a shocking secret about herself, her father, and their connection to GeneCo.

tmdb:11000.title: The Birdcage
tmdb:11000.overview: A gay cabaret owner and his drag queen partner agree to put up a false heterosexual front so that their son can introduce them to his fiancée's conservative parents.

tmdb:280.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
tmdb:280.overview: Ten years after the events of the original, a reprogrammed T-800 is sent back in time to protect young John Connor from the shape-shifting T-1000. Together with his mother Sarah, he fights to stop Skynet from triggering a nuclear apocalypse.

tmdb:8413.title: Event Horizon
tmdb:8413.overview: In 2047, a group of astronauts are sent to investigate and salvage the starship Event Horizon which disappeared mysteriously seven years before on its maiden voyage. However, it soon becomes evident that something sinister resides in its corridors.

tmdb:9871.title: Ginger Snaps
tmdb:9871.overview: The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger and Brigitte, in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself.

tmdb:28752.title: The Curse of the Werewolf
tmdb:28752.overview: A child conceived by a mute servant girl transforms from an innocent youth to a killer beast at night with uncontrollable urges.

tmdb:274.title: The Silence of the Lambs
tmdb:274.overview: Clarice Starling is a top student at the FBI's training academy.  Jack Crawford wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath, serving life behind bars for various acts of murder and cannibalism.  Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out.

tmdb:30497.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
tmdb:30497.overview: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way, they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.

tmdb:1482938.title: Union County
tmdb:1482938.overview: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

tmdb:298235.title: Capone Cries a Lot
tmdb:298235.overview: Umiemon is a naniwa-bushi singer who travels with his wife to the United States in hopes of achieving fame and fortune.

tmdb:27292.title: Prime Cut
tmdb:27292.overview: A group of ruthless Chicago mob enforcers are sent to Kansas City to settle things with the owner of a slaughterhouse who has taken money that is not his to keep.

tmdb:1278622.title: Black Is Beautiful
tmdb:1278622.overview: This short documentary film tells the story of a man who uses his talents to support and lift his community. The Black is Beautiful initiative is a collaborative effort amongst the brewing community and its customers, in an attempt to bring awareness to the injustices that many people of color face daily. This mission is to bridge the gap that's been around for ages and provide a platform to show that the brewing community is an inclusive place for everyone of any color.

t:other cinema post kolonial spectres.title: Other Cinema: Post-Kolonial Spectres
t:other cinema post kolonial spectres.overview: A true breakthrough and international discovery!! Here in-person with A Human Year Is Seven Earth Years, Honduran-American Adrian Quetzal Randall has cooked up an unprecedented Meso-American mystery play, an extremely sophisticated personal cine-essay that opens up areas of speculative history in an Adam Curtis-esque stream-of-consciousness  revelation on the military origins of Central American telecommunications and programming, tracing a psychedelic labyrinth across four continents. Part media archeology, part film diary, an endless montage of archival opticals support a long-form whispered confession about the electromagnetic magick that inflected the development of “modern” Honduran national sensibility. Our co-hit is Riar Rizaldi‘s equally paranoid Tellurian Drama, a sublime 25-min excavation of the colonial mythos surrounding the infamous Malabar Radio Antenna, a mysterious site of etheric conspiracy now being resurrected as a tourist destination on the Indonesian island of Java. $13

t:other cinema incredibly strange music.title: Other Cinema: Incredibly Strange Music
t:other cinema incredibly strange music.overview: Here’s an aggressive critical engagement with both old and new pop-rhetorical tropes, led by legendary beatnik re-mixer 99 Hooker! His much-anticipated appearance here promises both wise and wise-guy versions of the comtempo sub-pop-music scene, as well as genius patter in situ. Avatar Pit, his real-time media delirium, is supported fore and aft by a raft of utterly anomalous musical singularities—spontaneous musique concrete sessions, damaged polka fragments, Troloman, Babalu, the Blob, the Residents, Eric Burden and the Animals, Chrissie Hynde and the Pretenders…rockin hard! AND Liberace, Spike Jones, the Mirror Man, Louis Prima & Keely Smith, singing ostriches, and so many Other outsiders, now centerstage in 99‘s upside-down musical universe!! $14

tmdb:11976.title: Legend
tmdb:11976.overview: Set in a timeless mythical forest inhabited by fairies, goblins, unicorns and mortals, this fantastic story follows a mystical forest dweller, chosen by fate, to undertake a heroic quest. He must save the beautiful Princess  Lili and defeat the demonic Lord of Darkness, or the world will be plunged into a never-ending ice age.

tmdb:564.title: The Mummy
tmdb:564.overview: Dashing legionnaire Rick O'Connell stumbles upon the hidden ruins of Hamunaptra while in the midst of a battle to claim the area in 1920s Egypt. It has been over three thousand years since former High Priest Imhotep suffered a fate worse than death as a punishment for a forbidden love—along with a curse that guarantees eternal doom upon the world if he is ever awoken.

tmdb:138.title: Dracula
tmdb:138.overview: A British estate agent travels to Transylvania to meet the mysterious Count Dracula, who is interested in leasing a London castle. After Dracula enslaves the agent and drives him to insanity, the pair return to London together, where Dracula, a secret bloodsucker, begins preying on socialites.

tmdb:3035.title: Frankenstein
tmdb:3035.overview: Henry Frankenstein pieces together body parts in the hope of bringing a human-like creature to life. The mad scientist’s dreams are shattered by his monstrous creation awakening with rage to a world that hates and fears him.

tmdb:948.title: Halloween
tmdb:948.overview: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.

tmdb:12122.title: Village of the Damned
tmdb:12122.overview: An American village is visited by some unknown life form which leaves the women of the village pregnant. Nine months later, the babies are born, and they all look normal, but it doesn't take the "parents" long to realize that the kids are not human or humane.

tmdb:1493.title: Miss Congeniality
tmdb:1493.overview: When the local FBI office receives a letter from a terrorist known only as 'The Citizen', it's quickly determined that he's planning his next act at the Miss America beauty pageant. Because tough-as-nails Gracie Hart is the only female Agent at the office, she's chosen to go undercover as the contestant from New Jersey.

tmdb:1283515.title: Verify (Early Access)
tmdb:1283515.overview: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

tmdb:1114866.title: Blackbird Blackbird Blackberry
tmdb:1114866.overview: In a small traditional Georgian village, Etero, the owner of a housekeeping shop, is a forty-eight-year-old spinster. She cherishes her freedom, as much as her cakes, and is preparing for a peaceful and comfortable retirement away from gossip. But a fiery affair with her delivery man could derail all her plans.

tmdb:649804.title: A Tunnel
tmdb:649804.overview: An old railway station in a remote valley of Georgia suddenly becomes a site for a big change, when hundreds of Chinese settle around it to build the New Silk Road.

tmdb:776556.title: Taming the Garden
tmdb:776556.overview: Georgia’s former prime minister has found a unique hobby. He collects century-old trees, some as tall as 15-story buildings, from communities along the Georgian coast. At a great expense and inconvenience, these ancient giants are uprooted from their lands to be transplanted in his private garden.

tmdb:765421.title: Crossing
tmdb:765421.overview: Lia, a retired teacher from Georgia, learns from her young neighbor, Achi, that her long-lost transgender niece, Tekla, has crossed the border into Turkey. In search of Tekla, Lia travels to Istanbul with the unpredictable Achi, where they explore the hidden depths of the city.

t:english teacher and bakhmaro 2050.title: English Teacher and Bakhmaro 2050
t:english teacher and bakhmaro 2050.overview:
Georgia’s movement to teach English to schoolchildren is the backdrop for this beautifully observed documentary about an English teacher, Bradley Nelson from South Africa, and his experiences in a remote Georgian village, Sajijao. There he encounters both the warmth of the local community, and some resistance to the “linguistic revolution” as a national initiative. A finely drawn portrait of a critical moment in Georgia’s development as an independent nation in the post-Soviet era.

Before construction begins on a major housing complex in Bakhmaro, a resort town in western Georgia that travelers visit for the special healing properties of the air, filmmaker Anka Gujabidze observes life as it is. Employing superimpositions and dissolves, this documentary portrait ruminates on the changes that will come with construction and what will be lost.

t:incomplete day in the history of georg.key: t:incomplete day in the history of georgia 10 06 93
t:incomplete day in the history of georg.title: An Incomplete Day in the History of Georgia 10.06.93
t:incomplete day in the history of georg.overview: Derived solely from video recordings of Georgian parliamentary proceedings on June 10, 1993, when Eduard Shevardnadze was the head of state, An Incomplete Day in the History of Georgia presents the debate surrounding the introduction of Georgia’s national currency coupon to replace the Russian ruble. Members of parliament voice their concerns from the floor, questioning the resolutions presented by the vice prime minister and president of the National Bank. How should the country’s leaders proceed in light of domestic challenges such as starvation, fuel shortages, budget shortfalls, and rapid inflation? Viewed with hindsight, this document from the early days of Georgian independence reminds us how fragile the democratic process can be.

tmdb:1108475.title: Self-Portrait Along the Borderline
tmdb:1108475.overview: Anna Dziapshipa was born of the union between an Abkhazian man and a Georgian woman. In Self-Portrait Along the Borderline, she skilfully weaves together unique archives and fragments to offer a personal and political biography of Georgia-Abkhazia relations. This vibrant exploration foregrounds a divided identity caught between the margins.

tmdb:33470.title: Italianamerican and American Boy: A Profile of Steven Prince
tmdb:33470.overview:
Martin Scorsese’s documentaries are like portals to his sources of inspiration, and Italianamerican takes us to the heart of the matter via a conversation with his parents. As his mother prepares meatballs, she and her husband tell the stories of their families’ journeys from Sicily to Elizabeth Street, which speak volumes about the immigrant experience. American Boy is the realization of Scorsese’s idea for a film in which “a man sits down, tells his story, and little by little you see an era emerge, a way of life, a way of surviving.” He found the perfect subject in Steven Prince, a great storyteller, who played the gun dealer in Taxi Driver, a role for which he provided his own guns.

—Kate MacKay

tmdb:846806.title: Wet Sand
tmdb:846806.overview: A village on the Georgian Black Sea is full of friendly people convinced they know each other. One day, Eliko is found hanged. His granddaughter Moe comes to organize his funeral. She is confronted with a web of lies and the tragic consequences of Eliko's hidden love life with Amnon, which lasted 22 years. The truth however frees Moe’s capability to love and forces the villagers to take a stand.

tmdb:8073.title: Band of Outsiders
tmdb:8073.overview: Cinephile slackers Franz and Arthur spend their days mimicking the antiheroes of Hollywood noirs and Westerns while pursuing the lovely Odile. The misfit trio upends convention at every turn, be it through choreographed dances in cafés or frolicsome romps through the Louvre. Eventually, their romantic view of outlaws pushes them to plan their own heist, but their inexperience may send them out in a blaze of glory -- which could be just what they want.

t:films by the cousin collective and chr.key: t:films by the cousin collective and christophe katrib
t:films by the cousin collective and chr.title: Films by the COUSIN Collective and Christophe Katrib
t:films by the cousin collective and chr.overview: Founded in 2018 by Sky Hopinka, Adam Khalil, Alexandra Lazarowich, and Adam Piron, COUSIN was created to support Indigenous artists expanding traditional definitions of, and experimenting with, moving image form and genre. This program offers a selection of works made by COUSIN collective artists, including Hopinka’s 2017 consideration of the Dakota Access Pipeline protest and Lindsay McIntyre’s film about caribou and lichen—made using those materials in the photographic process. A short film by Lebanese artist Christophe Katrib reflects on the dissonance he experiences living on the stolen land of the United States as “U.S-backed Israel commits genocide and ethnic cleansing on Palestine and my homeland of Lebanon.”

tmdb:702789.title: Collaborations
tmdb:702789.overview: Stefanie Schulte Strathaus has spent a considerable amount of time living in Cairo and working closely with the staff at Cimatheque – Alternative Film Centre. She presents two recently completed restorations by the Egyptian archive. Sad Song of Touha by Atteyat Al Abnoudy is a dreamlike portrait of Cairo’s street performers, whose stories are told by the voice of poet Abdel Rahman El-Abnoudy. Hussein Shariffe’s The Dislocation of Amber was filmed in the city of Suakin, formerly a flourishing port in Sudan, now reduced to ruins. Also shown will be a selection of home movies shot in Egypt from the Rafla Collection, amassed by Magdy Rafla, a jeweler who was also a passionate film collector.

tmdb:1578.title: Raging Bull
tmdb:1578.overview: The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.

tmdb:43231.title: White Nights
tmdb:43231.overview: A middle-aged man meets a young woman who is waiting on a canal bridge for her lover's return.

tmdb:501048.title: Shaihu Umar
tmdb:501048.overview: Set in northern Nigeria towards the end of the 19th century, Shaihu Umar begins with a discussion between Islamic students and their renowned teacher, the wise man Shaihu Umar. Asked about his origins, Umar begins to tell his story: he comes from a modest background and is separated from his mother after his father dies and his stepfather is banished. His subsequent trials and tribulations are marked by slavery, and he is put to any number of tests until he finally becomes the adopted son of his Arabic master Abdulkarim. He attends Quranic school and is made an imam upon reaching adulthood. Following a particular dream, he resolves to search for his mother.

tmdb:262.title: The King of Comedy
tmdb:262.overview: Aspiring comic Rupert Pupkin attempts to achieve success in show business by stalking his idol, a late night talk-show host who craves his own privacy.

tmdb:10560.title: Center Stage
tmdb:10560.overview: A group of 12 teenagers from various backgrounds enroll at the American Ballet Academy in New York to make it as ballet dancers and each one deals with the problems and stress of training and getting ahead in the world of dance.

tmdb:762.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
tmdb:762.overview: King Arthur, accompanied by his squire, recruits his Knights of the Round Table, including Sir Bedevere the Wise, Sir Lancelot the Brave, Sir Robin the Not-Quite-So-Brave-As-Sir-Lancelot and Sir Galahad the Pure. On the way, Arthur battles the Black Knight who, despite having had all his limbs chopped off, insists he can still fight. They reach Camelot, but Arthur decides not  to enter, as "it is a silly place".

tmdb:814776.title: Bottoms
tmdb:814776.overview: Unpopular best friends PJ and Josie start a high school self-defense club to meet girls and lose their virginity. They soon find themselves in over their heads when the most popular students start beating each other up in the name of self-defense.

tmdb:377.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
tmdb:377.overview: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before. Krueger has now come back in the dreams of his killers' children, claiming their lives as his revenge. Nancy and her boyfriend, Glen, must devise a plan to lure the monster out of the realm of nightmares and into the real world...

tmdb:239.title: Some Like It Hot
tmdb:239.overview: In Prohibition-era Chicago, musicians Joe and Jerry witness a mob hit, and flee the state in an all-female band disguised as Josephine and Daphne, but further complications set in.

tmdb:4638.title: Hot Fuzz
tmdb:4638.overview: Former London constable Nicholas Angel finds it difficult to adapt to his new assignment in the sleepy British village of Sandford. Not only does he miss the excitement of the big city, but he also has a well-meaning oaf for a partner. However, when a series of grisly accidents rocks Sandford, Angel smells something rotten in the idyllic village.

tmdb:2593.title: The Fire Within
tmdb:2593.overview: Depressed Alain Leroy leaves the clinic where he was detoxified. He meets friends, acquaintances and women, trying to find a reason to continue living.

tmdb:246741.title: What We Do in the Shadows
tmdb:246741.overview: Vampire housemates try to cope with the complexities of modern life and show a newly turned hipster some of the perks of being undead.

tmdb:1091.title: The Thing
tmdb:1091.overview: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

tmdb:8337.title: They Live
tmdb:8337.overview: A lone drifter stumbles upon a unique pair of sunglasses that reveal aliens are systematically gaining control of the Earth by masquerading as humans and lulling the public into submission.

tmdb:1694.title: Re-Animator
tmdb:1694.overview: Conducting clandestine experiments within the morgue at Miskatonic University, scientist Herbert West reveals to a fellow graduate student his groundbreaking work concerning the re-animation of fresh corpses.

tmdb:653.title: Nosferatu
tmdb:653.overview: The mysterious Count Orlok summons a happily married real estate agent to his castle, located up in the Transylvanian mountains, to finalise a terrifying deal.

tmdb:992.title: Sherlock Jr.
tmdb:992.overview: A film projectionist longs to be a detective, and puts his meager skills to work when he is framed by a rival for stealing his girlfriend's father's pocketwatch.

tmdb:9392.title: The Descent
tmdb:9392.overview: After a personal tragedy, Sarah joins her friends on a caving expedition in the Appalachian Mountains. But when a rockfall traps them deep underground, their adventure turns into a nightmare. As they search for a way out, the group discovers they are not alone—lurking in the darkness are savage, cave-dwelling creatures. With rising tension and dwindling trust, the women must fight to survive against both the predators and each other.

tmdb:22970.title: The Cabin in the Woods
tmdb:22970.overview: Five friends set out for a weekend at a remote cabin in the woods, expecting nothing more than fun and relaxation. As night falls, they discover that something far more unsettling is at work and that nothing about their getaway is what it seems.

tmdb:46838.title: Tucker and Dale vs. Evil
tmdb:46838.overview: Two hillbillies are suspected of being killers by a group of paranoid college kids camping near the duo's West Virginian cabin. As the body count climbs, so does the fear and confusion as the college kids try to seek revenge against the pair.

t:cycle of love.title: CYCLE OF LOVE
t:cycle of love.overview: In 1977, PK, a 23-year-old Delhi street artist from a poor, ‘untouchable’ family, picked up a handful of paintbrushes and a second-hand bicycle and set off on a 6000-mile cross-continent mission – to find Lotta, the woman who had captured his heart. A love story like no other, THE CYCLE OF LOVE is an inspiring, heart-warming, epic true-life adventure about the search for self-belief and risking everything for what your heart tells you.

tmdb:653757.title: Once Upon a Time in Venezuela
tmdb:653757.overview: Once upon a time, the Venezuelan village of Congo Mirador was prosperous, alive with fisherman and poets. Now it is decaying and disintegrating—a small but prophetic reflection of Venezuela itself.

tmdb:1131123.title: The Filmmaker
tmdb:1131123.overview: A woman steals a man's identity and forces him to confront a secret that he's hidden for over thirty years.

tmdb:43797.title: Sun Valley Serenade
tmdb:43797.overview: When Phil Corey's band arrives at the Idaho ski resort its pianist Ted Scott is smitten with a Norwegian refugee he has sponsored, Karen Benson. When soloist Vivian Dawn quits, Karen stages an ice show as a substitute.
